12.issue_summary: App manages user accounts but does not provide an in-app account deletion mechanism.
12.evidence: AuthViewModel.kt and SettingsScreen.kt provide logout functionality (auth.signOut()), but lack any feature, UI control, or API integration for users to delete their account or request backend data erasure.
12.recommendation: Implement in-app deletion: Create a highly discoverable path (e.g., under User Profile/Account Settings) to let users initiate account deletion directly in the app.
